database: An rc2 database already starts from the baseline migration, so it is upgraded in place, not recreated. Stop Compose api/dispatcher and back up .lace/data and the object store, then run pnpm db:migrate (Cloudflare: pnpm cf:db:migrate or pnpm exec lace db migrate --target cloudflare-remote --operator-env .lace/cloudflare-operator.env); it applies only the checked-in forward migrations after the baseline. A database created before rc2 predates the baseline and is not supported: lace db migrate and lace doctor report SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED for it and change nothing.
configuration: Template 0.48.0: guides and upgrade instructions start at rc2 (template 0.47.0), the oldest supported release, and the operations guide describes the rc2 upgrade without database recreation. Upgrade all Lace packages and both images together, apply the database step, then run pnpm content:sync and rebuild the site.
